features.name: Improved Power BI Embed User Interface
features.description: Enhanced visual presentation of Power BI reports embedded in Business Central with cleaner UI, better margins, and optimized spacing that removes unnecessary buttons.

features.name: User Control Host Page Type
features.description: New AL page type designed specifically for hosting user controls and control addins. Removes unnecessary properties and triggers that don't apply to control addin contexts, providing a simpler development experience with optimized UI.
caveats: Actions are not currently supported in user control host pages
Source table property is not supported
Insertion, modification, and deletion properties do not apply

features.name: Simplified Property Model for User Control Host
features.description: User control host page type removes unsupported properties such as source table, insertion allowed, modification allowed, deletion allowed, and event triggers like on after get record that are not applicable to control addin scenarios.
caveats: Actions not yet supported but may be considered for future

features.name: Power BI Report Reflow and Responsive Design
features.description: Control addins using the new user control host page type dynamically reflow and resize to take necessary space within the Business Central page, with improved handling of margins and spacing.
